ai.summary: The article discusses Pakistan's political situation, focusing on the military's growing influence in governance without a coup, contrasting with India's democratic institutions. It covers Imran Khan's legal troubles, the election in Jammu and Kashmir, and a protest movement in Pakistan-occupied Kashmir that was banned and resulted in civilian deaths.

facts.claim: Pakistan has a prime minister, a two-chamber parliament, a Supreme Court, and an election in PoK
facts.quote: Pakistan has a prime minister, a two-chamber parliament, a Supreme Court, an election commission and, this summer, an election in PoK.

facts.claim: Imran Khan's party was denied its election symbol before the 2024 vote, but its candidates won more seats than anyone else as independents
facts.quote: His party was denied its election symbol before the 2024 vote, and its candidates still won more seats than anyone else as independents.

facts.claim: The Supreme Court ordered Imran Khan moved to a private hospital in August, but months later it has not happened
facts.quote: The Supreme Court ordered him moved to a private hospital in August, and months later it has not happened.

facts.claim: In Jammu and Kashmir, assembly elections were held in 2024 with strong participation, and an elected government took office
facts.quote: Assembly elections were held in Jammu and Kashmir in 2024, with strong participation, and an elected government took office.

facts.claim: A Joint Awami Action Committee, a coalition of traders, lawyers and students, asked for cheaper electricity, working hospitals and an end to elite privilege
facts.quote: The Joint Awami Action Committee, a coalition of traders, lawyers and students, asked for cheaper electricity, working hospitals and an end to elite privilege.

facts.claim: In June, the authorities banned the committee under anti-terror law, cut the internet and told outsiders to stay away
facts.quote: In June the authorities banned the committee under anti-terror law, cut the internet and told outsiders to stay away.

facts.claim: Police confirmed that security personnel were also killed, and federal ministers said those involved would be treated as rioters, not protesters
facts.quote: Police confirmed that security personnel were also killed, and federal ministers said those involved would be treated as rioters, not protesters.

ai.background_note: The article compares Pakistan's military-influenced governance with India's democratic institutions, highlighting the lack of civilian authority in Pakistan and the suppression of a protest movement in Pakistan-occupied Kashmir.
